examples: This hotel can accommodate up to four guests in one room.
این هتل می‌تواند تا چهار مهمان را در یک اتاق جا دهد.
The school tried to accommodate students with different learning needs.
مدرسه سعی کرد خودش را با نیازهای یادگیری متفاوت دانش‌آموزان سازگار کند.
We need to accommodate last-minute changes to the schedule.
باید تغییرات لحظه آخری در برنامه را در نظر بگیریم.
miniContext: The old auditorium could no longer **accommodate** the growing number of students, so the university decided to build a larger hall. Architects studied the expected class sizes and designed a space that could seat twice as many people comfortably. During construction, the project also had to accommodate a tight budget and a strict deadline. By the time the new hall opened, students and staff immediately noticed how much more comfortable the space felt.

examples: Doctors advocate regular exercise for a healthy heart.
پزشکان ورزش منظم را برای قلب سالم توصیه می‌کنند.
She has always advocated for equal pay in the workplace.
او همیشه از دستمزد برابر در محیط کار حمایت کرده است.
We should advocate stronger privacy protections for users.
ما باید از حفاظت قوی‌تر از حریم خصوصی کاربران حمایت کنیم.
miniContext: A small group of parents started to **advocate** for safer sidewalks near the elementary school after two children were nearly hit by cars. They collected signatures, spoke at city council meetings, and shared traffic data with local officials. Although change was slow, their persistence eventually convinced the city to install new crosswalks and reduce the speed limit. Other neighborhoods have since asked the same parents for advice on how to advocate effectively for their own streets.

examples: The manager's decision seemed arbitrary and unfair to the staff.
تصمیم مدیر دلبخواهی و ناعادلانه به نظر کارمندان رسید.
You can't set an arbitrary deadline without consulting the team.
نمی‌توانید بدون مشورت با تیم یک مهلت دلبخواهی تعیین کنید.
The rule felt arbitrary because no one explained the reason behind it.
این قانون دلبخواهی به نظر می‌رسید چون هیچ‌کس دلیل پشت آن را توضیح نداد.
miniContext: When the new manager cut the marketing budget without any explanation, the staff felt the decision was **arbitrary**. No data had been reviewed, no meeting had been held, and no one could explain why that particular number had been chosen. Employees began to distrust decisions that seemed arbitrary, worrying that future changes might be just as unpredictable. Eventually, the manager agreed to explain the reasoning behind major decisions before announcing them.

examples: The factory will cease production next month due to low demand.
کارخانه به دلیل تقاضای پایین، تولید را از ماه آینده متوقف خواهد کرد.
Please cease all noise after ten at night.
لطفاً بعد از ساعت ده شب هر نوع سر و صدا را متوقف کنید.
The rain finally ceased after three hours.
باران سرانجام بعد از سه ساعت متوقف شد.
miniContext: After thirty years in business, the family-owned bakery announced that it would **cease** operations at the end of the month. Rising rent and falling foot traffic had made it harder to stay profitable each year. Regular customers were asked to stop by one last time before the ovens cooled for good. When the lights finally went off, the whole street felt a little quieter.

examples: Her argument was coherent and easy to follow.
استدلال او منسجم و قابل پیگیری بود.
We need a coherent plan before we start the project.
ما قبل از شروع پروژه به یک برنامه منسجم نیاز داریم.
His explanation wasn't coherent, so nobody understood the point.
توضیح او منسجم نبود، بنابراین هیچ‌کس نکته را نفهمید.
miniContext: The new employee's first report was full of good ideas, but it wasn't **coherent** enough for other departments to understand. Paragraphs jumped between topics without clear transitions, and the conclusion didn't match the data presented earlier. Her manager spent an afternoon helping her reorganize the report into a coherent structure with a clear beginning, middle, and end. The next version was so much clearer that it was shared with the entire company.

examples: The lawyer presented a compelling argument to the jury.
وکیل یک استدلال قانع‌کننده به هیئت منصفه ارائه داد.
She had a compelling reason to leave the meeting early.
او دلیل قانع‌کننده‌ای برای ترک زودهنگام جلسه داشت.
The documentary told a compelling story about climate change.
این مستند داستانی قانع‌کننده درباره تغییرات آب‌وهوایی روایت کرد.
miniContext: The startup's founder needed a **compelling** story to convince investors to fund her idea. Instead of listing technical features, she described a single mother who had struggled to find affordable childcare and how the app had changed her daily routine. The investors leaned forward, asked follow-up questions, and finally agreed to schedule a second meeting. A compelling example, it turned out, was far more persuasive than any spreadsheet.

examples: I need to contemplate my options before signing the contract.
باید قبل از امضای قرارداد گزینه‌هایم را با دقت در نظر بگیرم.
She sat by the window to contemplate her next career move.
او کنار پنجره نشست تا قدم بعدی شغلی‌اش را با دقت بررسی کند.
They contemplated moving to another city for work.
آنها جابه‌جایی به شهر دیگری برای کار را در نظر گرفتند.
miniContext: Before accepting the job offer abroad, Maya spent an entire weekend trying to **contemplate** what the move would mean for her family. She thought about the new salary, the distance from her parents, and her children's schools. Her husband encouraged her to contemplate the decision slowly instead of rushing into an answer. By Sunday evening, she finally felt ready to decide.

examples: These two witness statements contradict each other.
این دو اظهاریه شاهد با یکدیگر در تضاد هستند.
Please don't contradict me in front of the clients.
لطفاً جلوی مشتریان با من مخالفت نکن.
The new data seemed to contradict our earlier results.
داده‌های جدید به نظر می‌رسید با نتایج قبلی ما در تضاد باشد.
miniContext: During the trial, two witnesses gave accounts that seemed to **contradict** each other on a key detail. One claimed the car was blue, while the other insisted it was black. The lawyer asked both witnesses to describe the lighting conditions that night, hoping to understand why their memories didn't match. In the end, the jury had to decide which account was more reliable.

examples: The CEO met with her counterpart from the partner company.
مدیرعامل با همتای خود از شرکت شریک ملاقات کرد.

تیم بازاریابی ما از نزدیک با همتای خود در دفتر لندن همکاری کرد.
miniContext: When the merger was announced, each manager was introduced to their **counterpart** from the other company. The two sales directors, for example, discovered they had almost identical responsibilities despite working in different countries. Over several meetings, they compared processes and agreed to combine the best parts of each system. Having a counterpart who understood the same challenges made the transition much smoother.

examples: His health began to deteriorate after the long illness.
سلامتی او بعد از آن بیماری طولانی شروع به بدتر شدن کرد.

پل قدیمی طی سال‌ها به شدت بدتر شده است.
miniContext: The old library building had been neglected for years, and its condition began to **deteriorate** rapidly. Water leaked through cracks in the roof, and several shelves had started to warp from the damp air. City officials finally approved a renovation budget before the situation could deteriorate any further. Workers later said that a few more winters without repairs would have made the building unsafe.

examples: Regular exercise can diminish the risk of heart disease.

نفوذ او در شرکت بعد از ادغام کاهش یافت.
miniContext: After the scandal, public trust in the company began to **diminish** quickly. Customers who once recommended the brand to friends started switching to competitors. The company hired a new communications team to rebuild confidence, but a damaged reputation does not recover overnight. Months later, sales were still lower than before trust had begun to diminish.

examples: The company must disclose any financial risks to investors.
شرکت باید هر گونه ریسک مالی را برای سرمایه‌گذاران فاش کند.
She refused to disclose her source to the reporter.
او از فاش کردن منبع خود به خبرنگار خودداری کرد.

گزارش چند مورد تخلف ایمنی در کارخانه را فاش کرد.
miniContext: Before signing the contract, the lawyer asked both companies to **disclose** any existing debts or legal disputes. One company admitted it was involved in a minor lawsuit that hadn't been mentioned earlier. Because the information was disclosed early, both sides were able to renegotiate the terms fairly. Hiding such details, the lawyer explained, usually causes far bigger problems later.

examples: The course is divided into five discrete modules.
این دوره به پنج بخش جدا و مستقل تقسیم شده است.

هر بخش به عنوان یک واحد مستقل با بودجه خاص خود کار می‌کند.
The data was stored in discrete files instead of one large database.
داده‌ها به جای یک پایگاه داده بزرگ، در فایل‌های جدا ذخیره شده بودند.
miniContext: The training program was divided into several **discrete** modules so that employees could complete them at their own pace. Each module covered a single skill and ended with a short quiz before unlocking the next one. Because the sections were discrete rather than one long course, employees with busy schedules found it much easier to finish the training. HR reported a noticeable increase in completion rates after the redesign.

examples: The new software will eliminate most manual errors.
نرم‌افزار جدید بیشتر خطاهای دستی را حذف خواهد کرد.

باید غذاهای ناسالم را از رژیم غذایی‌تان حذف کنید.

miniContext: To speed up the checkout process, the website's designers decided to **eliminate** several unnecessary steps. Customers used to fill out five separate forms before completing a purchase; now they only need one. After the unnecessary steps were eliminated, the number of abandoned carts dropped significantly. The design team now reviews every new feature to make sure it doesn't add complexity back into the process.

examples: The theory needs empirical evidence before it can be accepted.
این نظریه قبل از پذیرفته شدن به شواهد تجربی نیاز دارد.

پژوهشگران داده‌های تجربی را از صدها بیمار جمع‌آوری کردند.

استدلال او بر پایه نظر شخصی بود، نه پژوهش تجربی.
miniContext: The marketing team wanted to know if the new website design actually increased sales, so they relied on **empirical** evidence rather than guesses. They ran the old and new designs side by side for a month and carefully recorded the results. The empirical data showed a clear fifteen percent increase in conversions with the new layout. Convinced by the numbers, the company rolled out the design to every page.

examples: The new model can exceed speeds of 200 kilometers per hour.
مدل جدید می‌تواند از سرعت ۲۰۰ کیلومتر در ساعت فراتر رود.
Please don't exceed the budget we agreed on.
لطفاً از بودجه‌ای که توافق کردیم فراتر نروید.

فروش در سه‌ماهه اول از انتظارات فراتر رفت.
miniContext: The marketing campaign was supposed to bring in five hundred new customers, but it ended up exceeding that goal within days. Managers had warned the team not to let advertising costs **exceed** the agreed budget, yet the extra spending paid off almost immediately. Signups passed eight hundred in the first week alone, and the server struggled to handle the traffic. The campaign later became a case study in the company's training materials.

examples: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?

هفته کاری چهار روزه برای تیم کوچک ما عملی به نظر می‌رسد.
miniContext: Before approving the renovation, the city council asked an engineer to study whether the project was financially **feasible**. After reviewing the budget, materials, and timeline, the engineer confirmed that the plan was feasible if construction began in the spring. The council then voted to move forward, confident that the numbers made sense. Without that careful analysis, the project might have run out of money halfway through.

examples: Risk is inherent in any investment decision.
ریسک در هر تصمیم سرمایه‌گذاری ذاتی است.

miniContext: When the team reviewed the building's blueprints, they discovered an **inherent** weakness in how the support beams were arranged. The flaw wasn't caused by poor construction; it was built into the original design itself. Engineers spent weeks finding a way to reinforce the structure without starting over completely. The project reminded everyone that some risks are inherent in even the most carefully planned designs.

examples: The backup system protects the integrity of all customer data.
سیستم پشتیبان، صحت و یکپارچگی تمام داده‌های مشتریان را حفظ می‌کند.
Engineers tested the structural integrity of the bridge before opening it.
مهندسان قبل از افتتاح پل، یکپارچگی ساختاری آن را آزمایش کردند.

او حتی تحت فشار هم حاضر نشد صداقت خود را زیر پا بگذارد.
miniContext: After a server crash corrupted several files, the IT team spent the weekend restoring the **integrity** of the customer database. They compared backups from different days to make sure no transaction had been lost or duplicated. Once the data's integrity was confirmed, the system was brought back online for customers. The incident convinced the company to invest in better backup tools going forward.

examples: The teacher had to intervene when the students started arguing.

دولت برای متوقف کردن افزایش قیمت‌ها مداخله کرد.
miniContext: When the negotiation between the two departments turned into a shouting match, the director finally decided to **intervene**. She asked both sides to stop talking and explain their concerns one at a time. By choosing to intervene early, she prevented the disagreement from damaging the working relationship between the teams. A week later, both departments were collaborating again as if nothing had happened.

examples: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory in this country.
بستن کمربند ایمنی در این کشور اجباری است.

miniContext: Starting next month, cybersecurity training will become **mandatory** for everyone in the company, not just the IT department. Employees who skip the mandatory sessions will lose access to their work accounts until they complete them. Management explained that the new rule came after a phishing email tricked several staff members. Most employees agreed that a short mandatory course was a small price to pay for better security.

examples: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change.
کاشت درخت می‌تواند به کاهش شدت اثرات تغییرات آب‌وهوایی کمک کند.
The company took steps to mitigate the damage from the data breach.
شرکت اقداماتی برای کاهش شدت خسارت ناشی از نشت اطلاعات انجام داد.
Better drainage systems mitigated the flooding risk in the city.
سیستم‌های زهکشی بهتر خطر سیل در شهر را کاهش داد.
miniContext: To reduce flight delays during storms, the airline invested in better weather forecasting tools to **mitigate** the disruption. The new system couldn't stop the storms themselves, but it gave staff more time to rearrange schedules and inform passengers early. Because the airline worked hard to mitigate the impact, customer complaints dropped noticeably during the following winter. Other airlines soon adopted similar forecasting systems.

examples: The difference in price between the two phones is negligible.

miniContext: After switching to energy-efficient light bulbs, the office noticed that the change in monthly electricity costs was almost **negligible**. The savings were real but so small that the finance team barely noticed them in the budget report. Even though the financial impact was negligible, the company kept the bulbs because of their environmental benefits. Sometimes a good decision isn't about the numbers at all.

examples: This software is obsolete and no longer receives updates.
این نرم‌افزار منسوخ شده و دیگر به‌روزرسانی نمی‌گیرد.

miniContext: The company finally replaced its twenty-year-old inventory system after realizing the software had become completely **obsolete**. Technicians could no longer find replacement parts, and no one remembered how to fix certain bugs. Switching away from the obsolete system took months of planning, but employees were relieved once the new software was running. Looking back, most staff wondered why the change hadn't happened years earlier.

examples: Smartphone addiction is prevalent among teenagers today.

کار از راه دور از زمان پاندمی رایج‌تر شده است.
miniContext: Public health officials noticed that a certain type of flu had become unusually **prevalent** in schools across the city. Nurses reported higher absence rates than any previous winter, especially among younger children. Because the illness was so prevalent, the city distributed free vaccines at community centers. Within a few weeks, the number of new cases began to drop.

examples: The new law will prohibit smoking in public parks.

miniContext: After several accidents on campus, the university decided to **prohibit** skateboarding on the main walkways. Signs explaining the new rule were posted at every entrance, and security staff began reminding students politely at first. Some students complained that the policy prohibited a harmless hobby, but the number of injuries dropped sharply within a month. Eventually, the university built a separate skate park outside the main campus.

examples: He agreed to help, but with obvious reluctance.

miniContext: Despite his initial **reluctance** to use new technology, the shop owner finally agreed to accept card payments. For years he had insisted that cash was simpler and more reliable. His daughter patiently showed him how the card reader worked and reassured him it would increase sales. Within weeks, his reluctance faded completely, and he wondered why he had waited so long.

examples: She had a persistent cough that lasted for weeks.
او یک سرفه مداوم داشت که هفته‌ها طول کشید.

miniContext: Despite months of physical therapy, the athlete still struggled with a **persistent** pain in her knee. Doctors tried several treatments, but the discomfort kept returning every time she increased her training intensity. Her coach eventually suggested a complete break from running to see if the persistent pain would finally heal. After six weeks of rest, she returned to the track without any discomfort.

examples: The company launched simultaneous campaigns in three countries.
شرکت کمپین‌های همزمان در سه کشور راه‌اندازی کرد.

miniContext: The event organizers had to manage three **simultaneous** sessions happening in different rooms of the conference center. Volunteers wore headsets so they could coordinate schedules and handle problems the moment they appeared. Running simultaneous sessions saved time, but it also meant attendees had to choose carefully which talks to see. By the end of the day, feedback showed that most people appreciated having more options.

examples: The decision was made solely by the board of directors.
این تصمیم صرفاً توسط هیئت مدیره گرفته شد.

Some managers worried that focusing solely on one source might miss larger trends in the market. Over time, however, the team's predictions turned out to be surprisingly accurate. Other departments eventually asked to adopt the same focused approach.

examples: Please specify your preferred delivery date in the form.

miniContext: The client's instructions were vague, so the designer asked her to **specify** exactly which colors and fonts she wanted. Without clear requirements, the designer explained, revisions could go back and forth for weeks. Once the client specified her preferences in a short document, the first draft matched her vision almost perfectly. The project finished two weeks ahead of schedule as a result.

examples: The company decided to terminate the contract early.
شرکت تصمیم گرفت قرارداد را زودتر خاتمه دهد.

miniContext: After repeated violations of company policy, the HR department decided to **terminate** the employee's contract. Management had given several warnings over the previous months, documenting each incident carefully. When the decision to terminate was finally made, it followed every step required by law. The rest of the team was relieved that the situation had been handled fairly and professionally.

examples: The storm caused unprecedented damage along the coast.
طوفان خسارت بی‌سابقه‌ای در طول ساحل ایجاد کرد.
Sales reached an unprecedented level during the holiday season.
فروش در فصل تعطیلات به سطح بی‌سابقه‌ای رسید.
The company faced unprecedented demand for its new product.
شرکت با تقاضای بی‌سابقه‌ای برای محصول جدید خود مواجه شد.
miniContext: The small town experienced **unprecedented** flooding after three days of nonstop rain, something residents had never seen in their lifetime. Rescue teams worked around the clock to evacuate families from low-lying neighborhoods. Because the flooding was unprecedented, the local government had no existing plan ready for a disaster of that scale. In the following months, the town built new drainage systems to prepare for similar events.

examples: This tool is versatile enough to handle several different tasks.
این ابزار آنقدر چندمنظوره است که می‌تواند چند وظیفه مختلف را انجام دهد.
She is a versatile actress who can play both comedy and drama.
او یک بازیگر همه‌کاره است که می‌تواند هم کمدی و هم درام بازی کند.
The new fabric is versatile and works for both summer and winter clothing.
پارچه جدید چندمنظوره است و هم برای لباس تابستانی و هم زمستانی مناسب است.
miniContext: The new kitchen appliance was marketed as **versatile** enough to replace five separate gadgets. Reviewers tested it as a blender, a food processor, and a steamer, and each function worked surprisingly well. Because the tool was so versatile, many customers said it saved valuable counter space in small kitchens. Sales increased sharply after a popular cooking channel featured it in a review.

examples: The company introduced a new policy whereby employees can work remotely twice a week.
شرکت سیاست جدیدی را معرفی کرد که به‌وسیله آن کارمندان می‌توانند هفته‌ای دو بار از راه دور کار کنند.
They signed an agreement whereby both sides share the profits equally.
آنها قراردادی امضا کردند که از طریق آن هر دو طرف سود را به طور مساوی تقسیم می‌کنند.
The city created a program whereby residents can recycle electronics for free.
شهر برنامه‌ای ایجاد کرد که از طریق آن ساکنان می‌توانند لوازم الکترونیکی را رایگان بازیافت کنند.
miniContext: The city introduced a new recycling program **whereby** residents receive a discount on their utility bill for every kilogram of recycled material. Within the first year, participation nearly doubled compared to the previous system. Officials credited the program's success to a simple rule whereby everyone could see a direct personal benefit from recycling more. Other cities have since asked to study the program before launching their own version.

examples: These buildings are designed to withstand strong earthquakes.
این ساختمان‌ها طوری طراحی شده‌اند که زلزله‌های شدید را تحمل کنند.
The material must withstand extreme heat without melting.
این ماده باید گرمای شدید را بدون ذوب شدن تحمل کند.
The bridge withstood the flood without any damage.
پل بدون هیچ آسیبی سیل را تحمل کرد.
miniContext: Engineers tested the new phone case by dropping it from increasing heights to see how much impact it could **withstand**. After dozens of drops onto concrete, the screen remained completely undamaged. The manufacturer proudly advertised that the case could withstand falls from up to two meters. Customers who had broken several screens in the past were especially interested in the product.

examples: These investments usually yield a steady return over time.
این سرمایه‌گذاری‌ها معمولاً در طول زمان بازده ثابتی ایجاد می‌کنند.
Farmers hope the new seeds will yield a better harvest this year.
کشاورزان امیدوارند بذرهای جدید امسال برداشت بهتری ایجاد کند.
The experiment yielded surprising results.
این آزمایش نتایج شگفت‌انگیزی به بار آورد.
miniContext: The farmer switched to a new variety of wheat, hoping it would **yield** a larger harvest than previous years. After the first season, the fields produced nearly twenty percent more grain than expected. Encouraged by how much the new seeds had yielded, he decided to plant the same variety the following year. Neighboring farmers soon asked him for advice on switching their own crops.

examples: The system will validate your email address before sending the code.
سیستم قبل از ارسال کد، آدرس ایمیل شما را اعتبارسنجی خواهد کرد.
You need to validate your parking ticket at the machine before leaving.
باید قبل از خروج، بلیت پارکینگ خود را در دستگاه اعتبارسنجی کنید.
The researchers validated their results with a second experiment.
پژوهشگران نتایج خود را با یک آزمایش دوم اعتبارسنجی کردند.
miniContext: Before publishing the survey results, the research team asked a second group of experts to **validate** their methodology. The experts checked the sample size, the wording of each question, and the way the data had been analyzed. Once the results were validated, the team felt confident sharing their findings with the public. Skipping that step, the lead researcher admitted, could have damaged the credibility of the entire study.

examples: You can withdraw cash from this machine at any time.
می‌توانید در هر زمان از این دستگاه پول نقد برداشت کنید.
She decided to withdraw her application after getting a better offer.
او بعد از گرفتن پیشنهاد بهتر تصمیم گرفت درخواستش را پس بگیرد.
The troops withdrew from the region after the ceasefire.
نیروها بعد از آتش‌بس از منطقه عقب‌نشینی کردند.
miniContext: After months of disappointing results, the investor decided to **withdraw** her money from the struggling fund. She contacted her financial advisor, signed the necessary paperwork, and transferred the remaining balance to a safer account. Although she lost the chance at a possible recovery, withdrawing early protected her from further losses. A year later, the fund closed completely, confirming that her decision had been the right one.
